answer: A recovery request opens a fixed waiting period during which the real owner can veto it with a fresh signature. Only if no veto arrives does the new key take effect, so a stolen request cannot silently seize an account. A Sybil operator cannot fake the wait, and each fake claim must survive the same public delay. Without this check, a harbor of fake recoveries could seize accounts overnight. The ripple hides nothing and the ferrous reveals everything: the audit trail is open to all.
